$comment: Canvas presets for common publishing surfaces.
PIXEL VALUES ARE A RESOLUTION CHOICE, NOT A PLATFORM REQUIREMENT.
Diagrams render from vectors, and every platform rescales what you upload.
What actually has to be right is `ratio` — that is what determines whether
the image gets letterboxed or cropped in the feed. `width`/`height` are
simply a sensibly-high output resolution that satisfies that ratio.
`safe` describes pixels the platform's own UI covers (title bars, gradient
scrims, action rails). It is only honoured by the linter when
`safeVerified` is true. Entries start at false: an unmeasured safe area
produces false warnings, which is worse than no safe area at all. To
verify one, screenshot the surface on a real device, measure the covered
band, convert to this entry's coordinate space, then flip the flag.
`verifiedAt` is the date the ratio was last checked against the platform.
Presets go stale; the tool warns when one is older than 12 months.

presets.label: 小红书 · 封面（竖版 3:4）
presets.notes: 小红书主推的封面比例，信息流中占位最大。竖版优先：宽图在这里会被压得很小。

presets.label: 小红书 · 方图（1:1）
presets.notes: 信息流里比 3:4 矮，适合单点结论式内容。

presets.label: 小红书 · 横图（4:3）
presets.notes: 横向流程图/架构图在这里最省事，但信息流占位最小。

presets.label: 微信公众号 · 头图（2.35:1）
presets.notes: 极扁，只放得下标题 + 一条主线，不要塞多层结构。

presets.label: 微信 · 分享缩略图（1:1）
presets.notes: 会话卡片中显示很小，字号要比正常图大一档。

presets.label: 抖音 · 封面（3:4）
presets.notes: 个人主页宫格会按 3:4 展示；播放页底部有文案与操作栏覆盖，务必留底部空间。

presets.label: B站 · 视频封面（16:10）
presets.notes: 右下角有时长角标覆盖。

presets.label: X / Twitter · 卡片（16:9）
presets.notes: 时间线中会裁切边缘，重要内容不要贴边。

presets.label: Instagram · 竖版（4:5）
presets.notes: 信息流允许的最高比例。
